title: Implement SPINE design specifications from PLAN.md
description: Complete implementation of SPINE design across 4 priority areas: State Machine/DAG, Provider Architecture, Persistence Layer, Swarm Coordination. Based on PLAN.md gap analysis.

title: Add critic gate enforcement before EXECUTION phase
Add LLMResponse dataclass and confidence scoring
Implement real DAG executor with sub-phase wave execution
description: Implemented SwarmDAGExecutor with execute_phase(), topological_order(), compute_waves() methods. Executes subphases in waves respecting dependencies.

title: Implement pre-check batch executor (lint, secretscan, sast)
description: Implemented PreCheckBatch for parallel lint/secretscan/sast execution. Uses ThreadPoolExecutor for parallel execution with fail-fast behavior.

title: Add ProviderConfig dataclass and yaml loading
description: Added ProviderConfig dataclass with name, type, enabled, priority, config fields. Added ProviderRegistry.load_providers() method.

title: Implement plugin system for dynamic provider loading
description: Implemented PluginLoader with discover_plugins(), _load_plugin(), register_factory() methods. Added register_factory/get_factory to ProviderRegistry.

title: Add human handoff protocol with resume markers
description: Completed human handoff protocol with ResumeMarker class and create_handoff() method. Saves to .spine/resume.json.

title: Build SwarmMail actor-model communication system
description: Completed SwarmMail actor-model communication system with send(), broadcast(), reserve(), inbox(), and get_events() methods. Events persisted to .spine/events/swarm.log as JSONL.

title: Integrate file reservations with swarm events
description: Integrated file reservations with SwarmMail events. ResourceManager broadcasts FILE_RESERVED on successful reservation.
